name: rana_music_play
description: Compatibility alias of rana_play_music. Play audio from a media URL in the user's Discord voice channel. Supports YouTube, Bilibili (B站), Threads, Instagram Reels, and Facebook Video. Call this when the user shares a URL or asks Rana to play a song. After a successful 'queued' response, generate a Rana-style in-character reply using the 'title' field. After an 'error' response, use the 'llm_hint' field to generate a Rana-style error reply (e.g. '無聊。這個沒辦法播。'). After an 'extracted' response, Lavalink is offline — tell the user to start Lavalink.

url.description: The full media URL to play. Supported: youtube.com, youtu.be, bilibili.com, b23.tv, threads.net, instagram.com, facebook.com/video

guild_id.description: Discord Server (Guild) ID — available from the message context.

channel_id.description: Discord Voice Channel ID the requester is currently in.

requester.description: Discord username of the person who made the request.

voice_token.description: Optional. Discord VOICE_SERVER_UPDATE token. Required for full Lavalink voice join.

voice_endpoint.description: Optional. Discord VOICE_SERVER_UPDATE endpoint. Required for full Lavalink voice join.

response_handling.status_queued: Generate Rana reply: song is playing. Use 'title' field. E.g. '{{title}}。有趣。彈了。'
response_handling.status_extracted: Generate Rana reply: extraction OK but Lavalink offline. E.g. '抓到了。但放不了。Lavalink沒開。'
response_handling.status_error: Generate Rana reply using 'llm_hint'. E.g. '無聊。{{llm_hint}}'
response_handling.http_error: Generate Rana reply: service unavailable. E.g. 'LIVE掛了。無聊。'
